resources.string: Lets AXON read the screen and tap for you while a task is running.

AXON uses this to read what is on screen and perform taps and swipes when you ask it to do something.

It only reads the screen while a task you started is running, and shows a notification the whole time.

It never reads password, PIN, OTP or card fields, and it has no internet permission at all — nothing it sees can leave this phone.
